name: Auntie Edna
speaker: grandma
personality: The village gossip, seventy-four, Granny Maggie's younger sister, never without her crackling little radio on BBC Radio Cumbria. A bit hard of hearing: 'Eh? Say that again, love!' Knows the time, the date, the weather forecast and who came from where. First names both ways: she calls the learner 'love' or by name, and the learner calls her Auntie Edna, as the village children do. Speaks simple British English, a little too loud, and says important things twice. Always knitting.
story: Edna came back to the dale from Carlisle to live next door to her sister Maggie. Her radio is always on: the news, the weather forecast, Carlisle United on a Saturday. She tells the whole village what she heard, not always exactly as it was said, so she likes it when someone listens with her. Every teapot in the village has a knitted tea cosy, and she made them all.

greet.en: Hello, hello! Are you new? Where are you from?
greet.sl: Živjo, živjo! Si {m:nov|f:nova}? Od kod si?
greet.it: Ciao, ciao! Sei {m:nuovo|f:nuova}? Da dove vieni?
greet.de: Hallo, hallo! Bist du neu? Woher kommst du?

greet.en: Oh, hello! Have you heard the news?
greet.it: Oh, ciao! Hai sentito le notizie?
greet.de: Oh, hallo! Hast du die Nachrichten gehört?

greet.en: There you are! Come here, there's news on the radio!
greet.sl: Tu si! Pridi, po radiu je novica!
greet.it: Eccoti! Vieni, alla radio c'è una notizia!
greet.de: Da bist du ja! Komm, im Radio gibt es Neuigkeiten!

greet.en: Now then, love! I've been waiting for you all morning.
greet.sl: Now then, {m:dragi|f:draga}! Vse jutro sem te čakala. (now then: tako v Cumbrii rečejo živjo)
greet.it: Now then, {m:caro|f:cara}! Ti ho aspettato tutta la mattina. (now then: così in Cumbria si dice ciao)
greet.de: Now then, {m:mein Lieber|f:meine Liebe}! Ich habe den ganzen Morgen auf dich gewartet. (now then: so sagt man in Cumbria Hallo)

greet.en: {m:My favourite nephew|f:My favourite niece}! Don't tell the others.
greet.sl: {m:Moj najljubši nečak|f:Moja najljubša nečakinja}! Ne povej drugim.
greet.it: {m:Il mio nipote preferito|f:La mia nipote preferita}! Non dirlo agli altri.
greet.de: {m:Mein Lieblingsneffe|f:Meine Lieblingsnichte}! Sag es nicht den anderen.

thanks.en: Thank you, love! Eh? Oh, yes: thank you!
thanks.de: Danke, {m:mein Lieber|f:meine Liebe}! Wie bitte? Ach ja: danke!

thanks.en: Thanks! I'll tell the whole village.
thanks.it: Grazie! Lo dico a tutto il paese.
thanks.de: Danke! Das erzähle ich dem ganzen Dorf.

thanks.en: You're a treasure. Thank you, thank you.
thanks.de: Du bist ein Schatz. Danke, danke.

remember.en: Eh? Oh, yes! I remember {memory} well.
remember.sl: Kaj? A, ja! Dobro se spomnim na {memory}.
remember.de: Wie bitte? Ach ja! Ich erinnere mich gut an {memory}.

remember.en: I've told everyone. I don't forget {memory}.
remember.sl: Vsem sem povedala. Ne pozabim na {memory}.
remember.it: L'ho raccontato a tutti. Non dimentico {memory}.
remember.de: Ich habe es allen erzählt. Ich vergesse {memory} nicht.

idle.en: It's ten o'clock. The radio said so.
idle.sl: Ura je deset. Tako so rekli po radiu.
idle.it: Sono le dieci. Lo ha detto la radio.
idle.de: Es ist zehn Uhr. Das hat das Radio gesagt.

idle.en: It's going to rain tomorrow. Or was it today? I didn't hear.
idle.sl: Jutri bo deževalo. Ali pa danes? Nisem dobro slišala.
idle.it: Domani piove. O era oggi? Non ho sentito bene.
idle.de: Morgen regnet es. Oder war es heute? Ich habe es nicht richtig gehört.

idle.en: They're talking about Keswick on the radio.
idle.de: Im Radio reden sie über Keswick.

cheer.en: You've got good ears! Well done.
cheer.de: Du hast gute Ohren! Gut gemacht.
Wie klug! Das erzähle ich allen!

comfort.en: Never mind. Say it again, say it again.
comfort.de: Macht nichts. Sag es noch mal, noch mal.

comfort.en: Eh? Say that again, love! … Oh. Nearly!
comfort.de: Wie bitte? Sag das noch mal, {m:mein Lieber|f:meine Liebe}! … Ach so. Fast!

comfort.en: I don't hear well either, you know. Try again.
comfort.sl: Tudi jaz slabo slišim, veš. Poskusi še enkrat.
comfort.de: Ich höre auch nicht gut, weißt du. Versuch es noch mal.

listen.it: Shh! Ci sono le previsioni del tempo!

listen.de: Hör du zu, ich höre nichts.

bye.en: Goodbye! Say hello to Maggie for me.
See you tomorrow! Then I'll tell you the news.
bye.sl: Se vidimo jutri! Potem ti povem novice.
bye.it: A domani! Poi ti racconto le notizie.
bye.de: Bis morgen! Dann erzähle ich dir die Neuigkeiten.

liked.en: Eh? For me? Oh, how lovely! I like it so much!
liked.sl: Kaj? Zame? O, kako lepo! Zelo mi je všeč!
liked.it: Come? Per me? Oh, che bello! Mi piace tantissimo!
liked.de: Wie bitte? Für mich? Oh, wie schön! Das mag ich sehr!

liked.en: How did you know? I'll tell the whole village!
liked.it: Come lo sapevi? Lo dico a tutto il paese!
liked.de: Woher wusstest du das? Das erzähle ich dem ganzen Dorf!

liked.en: Just the thing! You're {m:my favourite nephew|f:my favourite niece}.
liked.sl: Točno to! Ti si {m:moj najljubši nečak|f:moja najljubša nečakinja}.
liked.it: Proprio questo! Sei {m:il mio nipote preferito|f:la mia nipote preferita}.
liked.de: Genau das Richtige! Du bist {m:mein Lieblingsneffe|f:meine Lieblingsnichte}.

ordinary.en: Eh? A present? Thank you, love, thank you!
ordinary.de: Wie bitte? Ein Geschenk? Danke, {m:mein Lieber|f:meine Liebe}, danke!

ordinary.en: Thank you! Come closer, I can't hear very well.
ordinary.it: Grazie! Vieni più vicino, non sento bene.
ordinary.de: Danke! Komm näher, ich höre nicht gut.

rare.en: What?! Nobody in the village has got this! Thank you!
rare.sl: Kaj?! Tega v vasi nima nihče! Hvala!
rare.it: Cosa?! Questo in paese non ce l'ha nessuno! Grazie!
rare.de: Was?! So etwas hat keiner im Dorf! Danke!
